title: Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE (2^19 -> 2^18)
description: Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18, doubling optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute wall-clock budget while keeping model size (DEPTH=8) and all LRs/schedules unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb improved from 1.014027 (baseline) to 1.001440, a clear win from more, smaller optimizer steps rather than touching model shape. This is orthogonal to the depth-sweep proposals everyone else converged on this round, and suggests the batch-size/step-count axis is at least as leverage-rich as depth for this fixed-time regime. Worth a follow-up sweep (e.g. 2^17) in a later round if this becomes the baseline, and worth combining with whichever depth change wins, since the two levers are likely independent.
